meta.title: UPI Free Hai, Toh Banks Kamate Kaise Hain?
meta.audience: Consumers, GenZ shoppers, small business owners
meta.fullVoiceover: UPI free hai, toh paisa kahan se aata hai? Sach: UPI free nahi, bas tumhare liye free. August me 2,451 crore transactions! NPCI dukaandar se ₹2,000 se upar ke select payments pe 0.4 percent fee lega. Matlab ₹5,000 pe ₹20. Ye fee sirf merchant payments pe hai. Ye 15 October se aana tha, par Diwali ke baad tak taal diya gaya. Pro tip: bill me extra UPI charge dikhe toh pooch lo. Ye advice nahi hai. Follow karo @techwith.GenZ.
meta.instagramCaption:
🤯 UPI free hai, toh paisa kahan se aata hai? Peeche ka system free nahi hai 👇

📈 August 2026 me record ~2,451 crore UPI transactions hue
💸 NPCI ne select merchant payments (₹2,000 se upar) pe 0.4% MDR fee ka plan banaya hai
🧮 Example: ₹5,000 ka payment = ~₹20 fee, jo dukaandar se lagegi, customer se nahi
🔒 ₹75,000+ ke payments pe fee ka cap ₹300 hai
⏳ Ye 15 Oct se start hona tha, par Diwali ke baad tak taal diya gaya, nayi date abhi announce nahi hui

💡 Pro tip: bill me extra 'UPI charge' dikhe toh dukaandar se pooch lo.

Kya dukaandar ye kharcha customers par daalenge? Comment me batao 👇
Aur ye reel us dost ko bhejo jo roz UPI use karta hai 📲

Follow @techwith.GenZ for daily tech aur money updates.

⚠️ Disclaimer: Ye sirf educational information hai, financial advice nahi. Fee plan NPCI ke announcement par based hai aur badal sakta hai.
